top.title: Plateau Attack: Death toll rises to 19
top.description: By Golok Nanmwa JOS — The death toll from an attack on Tafi-Gana (Cando Zrreci), a community in Jebbu Miango, Bassa Local Government Area of Plateau State, has risen to 19 following the death of three persons who were rushed to hospital after the incident. The attack reportedly occurred on Wednesday night, November 25, and continued into the early hours of Thursday, November 26, 2026, throwing the community into confusion, fear and panic. A resident of the community, Moses Monday, who confirmed the casualty figure on Thursday, said 16 bodies were recovered at the scene, while three other victims died after being taken to hospital. Monday said: “This is evil. I can confirm that 16 bodies have so far been recovered at the spot, with an additional three who died after they were taken to the hospital. These evil men will not rest.” Another resident, Nuhu Fidelis, who also confirmed the attack, described it as another assault on a neighbouring community in Jebbu Miango. Fidelis said: “Yes, in the early morning of today, Thursday. Last night, November 25, 2026, a Christian neighbouring village, Tafi-Gana (Cando Zrreci), in Jebbu Miango, Bassa LGA, Plateau State, was attacked again. Many innocent people lost their lives.” He condemned the killings and called on the government and security agencies to take urgent measures to protect residents. Another resident, Paul Nehemiah, who said he lost a close relative in the attack, described the killings as wicked and unprovoked, adding that residents had been living in fear following repeated attacks. Nehemiah said: “We are tired of burying our people. These are farmers, women and children who did nothing to anyone. How long will this continue? We are calling on the government to rise up and save us.” Rita Joseph, whose family fled the village during the attack, said community members could no longer sleep peacefully because of persistent security threats. She said: “We ran into the bush with our children.” The residents appealed to the Plateau State Government, the Federal Government and security agencies to deploy more personnel to Miango and surrounding communities to prevent further attacks. They also urged the authorities to take decisive action to bring the perpetrators to justice and restore confidence among residents. Efforts to obtain comments from the Plateau State Police Command spokesman, SP Alfred Alabo, and his counterpart at Operation Enduring Peace, Captain Polycarp Chinonso Oteh, were unsuccessful, as they had yet to respond to inquiries by our correspondent as of the time of filing this report. top.title: Gov Bago Receives Report On 37 Miners Deaths, Pledges Full Implementation Of Recommendations
top.description: ‎Niger State Governor, Umaru Bago, has received the report of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry established to investigate the circumstances surrounding the deaths of 37 artisanal miners while in the custody of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC), Niger State Command. ‎The Governor received the report from the Chairman of the Commission, Justice Muhammad Muhammad, at the Government House, Minna, where he reaffirmed his administration’s commitment to implementing its recommendations. ‎Governor Bago expressed appreciation to the Commission on behalf of the bereaved families, the Miners Association and the NSCDC, describing the report as an important document that would guide stakeholders in addressing the circumstances surrounding the tragic incident. ‎He commended Justice Muhammad and members of the Commission for their dedication, sacrifices and thoroughness throughout the investigation, assuring that the government would carefully consider the findings and recommendations. ‎The Governor also disclosed that a copy of the report would be forwarded to the Presidency for reference, underscoring the importance of the investigation and its outcome. ‎Earlier, the Chairman of the Commission, Justice Muhammad Muhammad, thanked the Governor for the confidence reposed in the panel and the opportunity to serve. ‎He explained that the Commission received nine memoranda, conducted public hearings and carried out inspection visits to two mining sites, two NSCDC offices and the General Hospital in Minna as part of its investigation. ‎Justice Muhammad said the evidence and facts gathered during the proceedings formed the basis of the Commission’s findings and recommendations. ‎He further explained that the report was presented in three volumes for ease of reference, with Volume One containing the findings, observations and recommendations; Volume Two containing the records of proceedings; and Volume Three comprising all exhibits tendered before the Commission. ‎In his remarks, the Attorney General and Commissioner for Justice, Nasiru Mu’azu, described the deaths of the 37 artisanal miners as a grave incident in the history of Niger State. ‎He commended Governor Bago for demonstrating commitment to the rule of law by establishing the Judicial Commission of Inquiry to investigate the incident and ensure that the circumstances surrounding the deaths were thoroughly examined. ‎Mu’azu assured that the Ministry of Justice would carefully study the report and advise the government on appropriate actions and the next steps to be taken. ‎ ‎ The post Gov Bago Receives Report On 37 Miners Deaths, Pledges Full Implementation Of Recommendations appeared first on Channels Television .

top.title: Company was religious about backups but sinned by leaving them exposed
top.description: Welcome, once again, to PWNED, where we’re thankful every time someone leaves a password sticky note on a monitor or fails to delete a terminated employee’s admin account. But neither of those common occurrences is what we’ll be talking about today. Instead, our subject broke the number-one rule of backups: you gotta keep ’em separated. Our story comes courtesy of Da Li, who serves as global alliance manager at Info2Soft , a company that provides data protection and recovery software. At one point, a partner called him into a case where a Chinese vehicle parts manufacturer fell victim to a ransomware gang. Unfortunately, its backup was compromised too. The manufacturer had religiously backed up its manufacturing execution system (MES) and SAP orders, inventory, and finance systems every night. There was even a green dashboard that showed the backup process had succeeded, and someone checked that every morning. However, one Friday evening, crims broke into the network and found out that the backup server was joined to the same Windows domain as the rest of the network. The hackers found a plaintext password for the backup service account in a maintenance script on a file share and discovered that someone had used the very same password for a domain admin account. So the first thing the crooks did was delete every restore point on that backup server. Then they started encrypting the production servers to ransom them. “Every backup job had succeeded for three years,” Li said. “The failure was that the thing meant to save them could be reached with the same keys as the thing being attacked.” The results were devastating. With the MES and SAP data both gone, the plant couldn't schedule production, ship parts, or track them. By the time Li was called in, the plant had already resolved its ransomware situation. We don’t know whether it paid or not. The manufacturer did ask Li and his company to make sure that this couldn’t happen again. Li’s fix was not radical, but it was instructive. He made sure that the company now keeps its backup system outside the production domain, uses unique credentials, and requires MFA to reduce the risk of unauthorized access even if a password is compromised. He also made sure that the company keeps at least one offline backup and runs a test restore quarterly to ensure it’s prepared for emergencies.®

top.title: UHSAA associate director Jeff Cluff, 49, dies from complications from stroke
top.description: Jeff Cluff, UHSAA associate director Jeff Cluff, who spent the past 12 years as a director with the UHSAA and was a champion of the mission of high school athletics, passed away at t. George Regional Hospital late Wednesday evening surrounded by family after complications from a stroke. He was 49. Cluff suffered a stroke last year Thursday, and after the family updated his condition on social media Saturday, they received an outpouring of love and support from the thousands and thousands of people in the athletics community who Cluff impacted. UHSAA associate director Jeff Cluff presents the state championship trophy to Corner Canyon after winning the 6A girls volleyball state championship against Skyridge at the UCCU Center at Utah Valley University in Orem on Thursday, Oct. 30, 2025. | Tess Crowley, Deseret News Cluff joined the UHSAA in 2014 as the supervisor of officials. During his time with the UHSAA, he’s also served as the director of baseball, along with overseeing compliance and eligibility, media services, arbiter sports, website administration, ticketing operations and numerous other roles. Prior to that he worked 13 years in the Dixie State University (now utah Tech) athletics department. Here’s the official family statement through social media on Thursday morning. View this post on Instagram “It is with profound sadness that we announce the death of our beloved husband, father, brother, son and friend, Jeff cluff, 49, following complications from a stroke. Jeff died late Wednesday evening surrounded by loved ones. Born in Tooele, Utah, jeff built a life centered on faith, family, friendship and service to others. He had a remarkable ability to make everyone he encountered fell like the most important person in the room. He was genuine, fiercely loyal, quick-witted and unapologetically himself. He told you what you needed to hear, stood by you when it mattered most and was always looking for ways to help others. These were values he and Monica worked to instill in their children, because raising a good family was his life’s mission. Whether on a the baseball field, among friends or at home with his family, Jeff lived with integrity, kindness and a deep sense of fairness. Those who knew him as an umpire knew the same man we knew at home: honest, consistent, firm in his convictions and kind at heart. Jeff’s generosity extended far beyond those closest to him, and in keeping with his lifelong commitment to helping others, Jeff’s final act of generosity was to give the gift of life through organ donation, hopefully blessing the lives of others as he did ours. While our hearts are broken, we find comfort in our faith, the memories we share adn the extraordinary outpouring of love from the community. Hearing the countless stories of how Jeff touched the lives of others has been a tremendous source of strength for our family. The greatest tribute anyone could offer Jeff is to carry forward the qualities that defined him: show up for others

top.title: “RIZE Up Day” aims to empower Western PA middle schoolers
top.description: WPXI Approximately 200 middle school students from the Aliquippa and Shaler Area school districts gathered at the RIZE Sports Complex in Leetsdale on Tuesday for “RIZE Up Day.” The four-hour program engaged sixth-, seventh- and eighth-grade students in sports training, health workshops and career exploration. Organized by the Boys & Girls Clubs of Western Pennsylvania and hosted by RIZE Sports, the event took place at 1201 Brickworks Dr. Program organizers structured the day to help young people build confidence, maintain active lifestyles and learn about career opportunities in the sports and wellness industries. Chuck Cooper III addressed the students as the keynote speaker following opening remarks. Cooper is the president and chief executive officer of the Chuck Cooper Foundation. He is the son of Charles “Chuck” Cooper, the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame member who became the first African American drafted into the NBA. Participants took part in physical training spread across three activity rotations. Community coaches from the Cleveland Cavaliers directed basketball skills sessions, while players from the University of Pittsburgh women’s lacrosse team led agility and conditioning drills. Beyond athletics, the morning incorporated wellness and emergency response education. Representatives from the Children’s Institute of Pittsburgh guided students through mindfulness and yoga rotations. In a separate hands-on session, instructors from the American Heart Association provided students with foundational CPR training to teach basic life-saving skills. During lunch sessions, students attended a panel discussion focused on professional careers in sports. Jim Britt, executive director of SportsPITTSBURGH, served as moderator. The panel featured Rachel Brecht, chief people officer of the Pittsburgh Penguins; Ethan Lounsbury, senior director of marketing for the Pittsburgh Riverhounds; and Benjamin Moore, senior sports marketing manager at F.N.B. top.title: FIFA confirms cyberattack, says hackers stole personal, business data
top.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye FIFA has confirmed a criminal cyberattack that exposed a limited amount of personal and business information, while files linked to its abandoned World Cup stake-sale plan were not accessed. According to Reuters, a person with direct knowledge of the incident said less than 0.1 per cent of FIFA’s total data was affected and no files from the FIFA Forward Enterprise project were accessed. “FIFA can confirm that it has been the victim of a criminal cyberattack resulting in unauthorised access to a limited set of personal and business information,” a FIFA spokesperson told Reuters. The football governing body condemned the unlawful acquisition and publication of information, particularly personal data, calling it “a serious and unacceptable violation of privacy”. FIFA did not disclose when the attack took place, how many people or organisations were affected, or what business information was accessed. It also did not say whether any data had appeared online or where it may have been published. FIFA scrapped plans in July to sell private investors a stake in a new unit that would manage its events, including the World Cup. The proposal aimed to raise up to $4.2 billion by selling a 20 per cent stake. The post FIFA confirms cyberattack, says hackers stole personal, business data appeared first on Vanguard News .

top.title: Germany's Freigang to miss women's World Cup due do doping ban
top.description: FILE PHOTO - Germany's Laura Freigang pictured during a training Session Open to the Media Ahead of World Cup Qualifier. (is associated with: «Germany's Freigang to miss women's World Cup due do doping ban») Marc Schüler/dpa Germany national team player Laura Freigang will miss next year's women's World Cup in Brazil after she's been suspended for missing doping tests, the German Football Federation (DFB) said in a statement on Thursday. Freigang will be suspended until October 7, 2027 after she reached a settlement with the DFB, the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) and Germany's National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA). Proceedings against Freigang had been ongoing for months. The 28-year-old was accused of not being at the location she specified for a doping control on three occasions between March 2025 and February 2026. In June, the Eintracht Frankfurt captain explained that the missed tests "were not deliberately avoided appointments but inconsistencies or misunderstandings in the comprehensive details that have to be updated daily and which we as national team players have to update in the system on a daily and hourly basis." Freigang has 45 caps for Germany and has scored 17 goals, but hasn't been a regular starter recently.

top.title: As Nigeria Rethinks Teacher Education, Tunji Olowolafe Makes a Case for Better-Prepared Educators
top.description: What makes a good teacher? Beyond knowing a subject, a good teacher can understand students, inspire confidence, and help young people discover what they are capable of becoming. It was this broader responsibility of educators that Dr. Tunji Olowolafe explored while delivering the 2026 Convocation Lecture at the Sikiru Adetona College of Education, Science and Technology (SACOETEC), Omu-Ajose, Ogun State. Speaking on Monday, 23 November 2026, on the theme “The Dual-Mandate NCE-Degree Programme: Prospects, Challenges and the Future of Teacher Education in Nigeria,” he described the programme as an important opportunity to reposition teacher education. For decades, Colleges of Education depended on university affiliations to award Bachelor’s degrees, despite many possessing the academic capacity to run such programmes. The Federal Colleges of Education Act 2023 changed this, empowering eligible institutions to award degrees independently. Under the Dual-Mandate programme, students can complete three years of NCE training and proceed to another two years for a Bachelor’s degree in Education. Dr. Olowolafe explained that combining practical teaching skills with deeper academic knowledge would produce better-prepared educators. However, he cautioned that institutional autonomy must be supported by sustained funding, improved curricula and professional development. With Nigeria facing an estimated shortage of one million teachers, he also called for greater integration of vocational education, artificial intelligence and digital skills into learning. “AI can explain a quadratic equation at midnight, but it cannot offer the steady, empathetic guidance of a caring adult,” he said, emphasizing that artificial intelligence must complement, not replace, the human qualities of effective teaching. During the lecture, Dr. Olowolafe announced that the Tunji Olowolafe Foundation would establish a fully equipped, solar-powered Gbemisola Olowolafe Memorial ICT Centre (GOMTECH) with high-speed internet connectivity at SACOETEC. The Foundation is also committed to recognising academic excellence and outstanding teaching at the College. This includes recognising the College’s first-class degree graduates and NCE distinction holders, alongside the overall best NCE and degree graduates. Lecturers, selected based on student ratings, will also be honoured for their teaching contributions. The initiative builds on the Foundation’s existing investment in education, including Project Digi-Teach at Ekiti State University and GOMTECH in Are-Ekiti. For Dr. Olowolafe, the commitment to educators is also deeply personal. His mother was a teacher, his elder sister taught for years at Baptist Academy, Lagos, and his late wife, Gbemisola Olowolafe, was a lifelong educator. He recalled the influence of teachers who shaped his own experience, particularly Mr. Soewu of Methodist Boys’ High School , whose patience helped students understand difficult concepts without humiliation. top.title: Meet Nigeria’s Damilola Bolarinde, crowned Miss International Africa 2026
top.description: By Enitan Abdultawab Nigerian beauty queen Damilola Bolarinde has been crowned Miss International Africa 2026 after representing the country at the 64th edition of the Miss International pageant in Tokyo, Japan. The continental title was announced on Thursday, November 26, a day after the grand finale held on November 25, which featured 73 contestants from different countries. Bolarinde, popularly known as Queen Dammy, secured a place among the Top 20 contestants but did not advance to the Top 10. Her performance at the competition earned her the Miss International Africa title. The achievement adds to her growing profile in the Nigerian beauty pageant industry, having represented Lagos State at the 2025 Miss Universe Nigeria competition, where she emerged first runner-up behind Anambra State representative, Onyinyechi Basil. In April 2026, Bolarinde won the Face of Hope pageant, earning the right to represent Nigeria at the Miss International competition as Miss International Nigeria 2026. She defeated contestants representing Anambra and Rivers states, who finished as first and second runners-up, respectively, at the event held on April 19 at the Eko Convention Centre in Lagos. Meanwhile, Elizaveta Kuznetsova of Moldova won the overall Miss International 2026 crown, becoming the first contestant from her country to claim the title. Brittany Feeney of the United Kingdom finished as first runner-up, while Laura Glozarová of the Czech Republic came third. Victoria Kosasieputri of Indonesia and Khánh Như Lê of Vietnam completed the Top Five, finishing fourth and fifth, respectively. Bolarinde’s continental recognition marks another milestone in her pageant career and adds Nigeria to the list of countries represented among the award recipients at the international competition. top.title: Cole Hutson Could Join His Brother in One of the NHL’s Most Exclusive Clubs
top.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Only four defensemen have led all NHL rookies in scoring over the course of a season since 1943-44. One of them was Lane Hutson, who recorded 66 points with the Montreal Canadiens in 2024-25. Just two seasons later, his younger brother has a legitimate opportunity to become the fifth. Cole Hutson took over the NHL rookie scoring lead after recording three assists in the Washington Capitals’ 7-4 loss to the New Jersey Devils on Nov. 14. At the time, Hutson was the only defenseman among the league’s top 13 rookie scorers. The 20-year-old has since been overtaken by some of the young forwards having incredible rookie seasons of their own, but he scored his sixth goal of the season in Wednesday’s 7-3 victory over the Philadelphia Flyers, bringing him up to 16 points in 22 games and within four points of rookie scoring leader Roman Kantserov. Considering some of the talent that entered the league this season, the fact that we’re even having this conversation about Hutson is pretty remarkable. Cole Hutson Could Join Some Incredible Company Bobby Orr became the first defenseman in the NHL’s modern era to lead all rookies in scoring, recording 41 points with the Boston Bruins in 1966-67. It took another 22 years for a defenseman to accomplish the feat, with Brian Leetch recording 71 points for the New York Rangers in 1988-89. Quinn Hughes became the third with 53 points for the Vancouver Canucks in 2019-20 before Lane joined the group with his incredible rookie season in Montreal. Cole is currently scoring at a rate that would see him finish with roughly 61 points over an 84-game season. It would be an incredible accomplishment on its own, but imagine both Hutson brothers leading their respective rookie classes in scoring just two years apart. Neither was even selected in the first round of their draft. The Canadiens selected Lane 62nd overall in 2022, while the Capitals selected Cole 43rd overall in 2024. There are going to be plenty of conversations in the coming years about how so many teams managed to pass on both of them. At the time, St. Ivany had spent more than 77% of his five-on-five ice time with Washington alongside Hutson, and what I’ve really liked about their partnership is how comfortable St. Ivany has been letting Hutson go to work offensively. Capitals head coach Spencer Carbery has spoken about St. Ivany’s ability to recognize when Hutson is getting involved offensively and adjust his positioning accordingly. When you’ve got a defenseman as talented and creative as Hutson, finding him a partner who understands how to play off him can go a long way toward getting the most out of his abilities. top.title: Stale links on UK public sector websites direct visitors to gambling dens
top.description: UK public sector websites are directing visitors to gambling promotions through old links to defunct local enterprise partnerships (LEPs), research by digital consultancy Digital Royalty has found. The consultancy identified 93 links across 79 pages on websites belonging to 26 public bodies. LEPs brought together councils and businesses to promote economic growth in England under a coalition government initiative launched in 2010. Central government funding ended in April 2024, with their core functions transferred to local and combined authorities. Among other things, Digital Royalty builds and looks after websites, which means chasing down old links. top.title: Wild NHL fight goes on forever — and teammates’ reaction says it all
top.description: Tyrel Bauer #77 of the Winnipeg Jets and Tanner Jeannot #84 of the Boston Bruins fight during a game at TD Garden in Boston, Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026. BOSTON — Boston’s Tanner Jeannot and Winnipeg’s Tyrel Bauer squared off at center ice in the first period on Wednesday night and put on one of the longest fights seen in the NHL in a while. The 6-foot-3 Bauer and the 6-2 Jeannot dropped the gloves near the center circle, then circled for about 20 seconds, looking for the right moment to make their move, before throwing more than 40 punches over nearly a minute in the Jets’ 4-2 victory over the Bruins. Not every punch landed, but Bauer’s helmet was knocked off, Jeannot got spun around, and when it was over and they were in the penalty box, both benches emptied, and the players went over to fist pound their respective teammates. Tyrel Bauer #77 of the Winnipeg Jets and Tanner Jeannot #84 of the Boston Bruins fight during a game at TD Garden in Boston, Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026. NHLI via Getty Images “One of the best fights I’ve seen,” said Bruins second-year coach Marco Sturm, who played in the NHL for 14 seasons. “Jeano, holy moly,” Sturm said. “Unbelievable.” Jeannot and Bauer were seen on the ice talking during warmups and, likely, planned to square off. Talk about letting the boys go What a fight pic.twitter.com/ZPDZTDuD5G — Barstool Sports (@barstoolsports) November 26, 2026 They earned the respect of their teammates by trying to boost the energy for their respective teams. “That’s just two really tough customers,” said Jets center Morgan Barron, who scored a second-period go-ahead goal. “You see Tyrel in those fights, he stands in there as long as the other guy is willing to. I think it was just great, it got the guys some energy. That’s a really difficult job to do.” The Bruins felt the same way. “It’s unbelievable,’’ said Boston center Fraser Minten of Jeannot. “He’s like the nicest guy, an unbelievable teammate. Just an absolute warrior out there.” The Boston Bruins bench looks on as a first-period fight between Tyrel Bauer and Tanner Jeannot on Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026, at TD Garden in Boston. NHLI via Getty Images Sturm has certainly seen his share of “tough guys” or what the league used to call “enforcers,” but he has great respect for what the two had to do. “I came in as young kid in this league and all the fights were pretty much open and you just go,” he said. “There was no defense, no structure. You just: ‘Go, Go.’ “That was wild,” he said. “In today’s world, there’s a lot of technique. … In today’s game, I think Jeano is elite and he showed it today.”

top.description: Where RBL currently stand in the race for the UCL play-offs Following our 3-1 win over RC Lens , the Red Bulls now sit 23rd in the table , putting us in a play-off spot. There are three games left in the Champions League league phase, and we're determined to pick up as many points as possible ! “ Every game is important now , which is why today's win was so valuable. We've still got a few games to play and we want to try and pick up as many points as possible. Every point counts ,” Antonio Nusa said afterwards. Manchester United clash could prove pivotal for RBL Automatic qualification for the Champions League round of 16 still looks some way off, with four points separating us from eighth-placed Manchester City . Having already faced two of the competition's strongest sides in Real Madrid and Manchester City during the first half of the league phase, we've got three challenging but winnable games ahead of us . A win away at Manchester United in two weeks' time would see us leapfrog the Red Devils, who currently sit 19th with seven points. United drew 2-2 with Sporting CP on matchday 5 under new head coach Mauricio Pochettino . It's been a difficult season for the English side, who currently sit second from bottom in the Premier League . Our two remaining opponents, Shakhtar Donetsk (26th) and Feyenoord (32nd), are both below us in the standings. They suffered 1-0 defeats to Fenerbahçe and Porto respectively. “We'll go to Manchester full of belief” RBL are off to the iconic Old Trafford on 8th December, where we've got some unfinished business. We suffered a 5-0 defeat in Manchester back in 2020, but won the reverse fixture 3-2 at the Red Bull Arena . “We've been making good progress as a team for several weeks now. We'll go to Manchester full of belief and try to get all three points. It won't be easy, but we'll be ready and we'll fight ,” said Martín Demichelis . Nine points were enough to secure a play-off spot last season, while 11 were needed in 2024/25 , the first season under the new league phase format. We missed out on the knockout stages that year, finishing with just three points. top.title: Real Madrid superstar equals Ferenc Puskas’ record with goal against PSV
top.description: Real Madrid superstar equals Ferenc Puskas’ record with goal against PSV Real Madrid staged an excellent second-half comeback to secure a 5-1 win over PSV Eindhoven in the UEFA Champions League this midweek. Kylian Mbappe scored a brace and was subsequently nominated for the UCL Player of the Week . But the Frenchman had actually gifted his MOTM award to Vinicius Jr. It was an important game for the Brazilian international, who scored for Real Madrid for the first time in three months. In doing so, he has achieved a key milestone. Vinicius Jr. levels Puskas’ record Thanks to his late goal against PSV, Vinicius has now netted his 35th goal for Real Madrid in the Champions League, drawing him level with club legend Ferenc Puskas, reports Defensa Central . It was a special night for Vinicius. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images) Vinicius Jr. now stands fifth in the all-time list of goalscorers for Real Madrid in the competition, behind only an iconic quartet of Alfredo Di Stefano (49), Raul Gonzalez (66), Karim Benzema (78) and Cristiano Ronaldo (105). This is quite the achievement for a player who has been central to Real Madrid’s recent success and has already bagged two Champions League trophies. In the overall scheme of things, Vinicius currently sits 24th, just one goal behind Puskas. His teammate Kylian Mbappe is further ahead in fifth spot with 76 goals, but a majority of them came in PSG colours. A touching show of unity Apart from the milestone, it was a special goal for Vinicius in many ways, as the forward has been struggling with form throughout the entirety of the season so far. Vinicius Jr. has shown early signs of promise. (Photo by Denis Doyle/Getty Images) That is why the Real Madrid team showed exceptional unity when the Brazilian international did eventually find the back of the net, with Mbappe being at the heart of it. Despite being named the MOTM, the Frenchman handed the award to Vinicius, in a gesture of recognition for his efforts on the night. Vinicius Jr. himself was moved by the gesture and thanked his teammates after the game. “Very happy for how my teammates have celebrated a goal that I needed. We are a family. Thank you very much, really. I love you all, let’s go for more!” he wrote after the game. This chimes in well with reports that the entire Real Madrid team are now all in on helping Vini get back to his best.

nigeria.title: Plateau Attack: Death toll rises to 19
nigeria.description: By Golok Nanmwa JOS — The death toll from an attack on Tafi-Gana (Cando Zrreci), a community in Jebbu Miango, Bassa Local Government Area of Plateau State, has risen to 19 following the death of three persons who were rushed to hospital after the incident. The attack reportedly occurred on Wednesday night, November 25, and continued into the early hours of Thursday, November 26, 2026, throwing the community into confusion, fear and panic. A resident of the community, Moses Monday, who confirmed the casualty figure on Thursday, said 16 bodies were recovered at the scene, while three other victims died after being taken to hospital. Monday said: “This is evil. I can confirm that 16 bodies have so far been recovered at the spot, with an additional three who died after they were taken to the hospital. These evil men will not rest.” Another resident, Nuhu Fidelis, who also confirmed the attack, described it as another assault on a neighbouring community in Jebbu Miango. Fidelis said: “Yes, in the early morning of today, Thursday. Last night, November 25, 2026, a Christian neighbouring village, Tafi-Gana (Cando Zrreci), in Jebbu Miango, Bassa LGA, Plateau State, was attacked again. Many innocent people lost their lives.” He condemned the killings and called on the government and security agencies to take urgent measures to protect residents. Another resident, Paul Nehemiah, who said he lost a close relative in the attack, described the killings as wicked and unprovoked, adding that residents had been living in fear following repeated attacks. Nehemiah said: “We are tired of burying our people. These are farmers, women and children who did nothing to anyone. How long will this continue? We are calling on the government to rise up and save us.” Rita Joseph, whose family fled the village during the attack, said community members could no longer sleep peacefully because of persistent security threats. She said: “We ran into the bush with our children.” The residents appealed to the Plateau State Government, the Federal Government and security agencies to deploy more personnel to Miango and surrounding communities to prevent further attacks. They also urged the authorities to take decisive action to bring the perpetrators to justice and restore confidence among residents. Efforts to obtain comments from the Plateau State Police Command spokesman, SP Alfred Alabo, and his counterpart at Operation Enduring Peace, Captain Polycarp Chinonso Oteh, were unsuccessful, as they had yet to respond to inquiries by our correspondent as of the time of filing this report. nigeria.title: Gov Bago Receives Report On 37 Miners Deaths, Pledges Full Implementation Of Recommendations
nigeria.description: ‎Niger State Governor, Umaru Bago, has received the report of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry established to investigate the circumstances surrounding the deaths of 37 artisanal miners while in the custody of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC), Niger State Command. ‎The Governor received the report from the Chairman of the Commission, Justice Muhammad Muhammad, at the Government House, Minna, where he reaffirmed his administration’s commitment to implementing its recommendations. ‎Governor Bago expressed appreciation to the Commission on behalf of the bereaved families, the Miners Association and the NSCDC, describing the report as an important document that would guide stakeholders in addressing the circumstances surrounding the tragic incident. ‎He commended Justice Muhammad and members of the Commission for their dedication, sacrifices and thoroughness throughout the investigation, assuring that the government would carefully consider the findings and recommendations. ‎The Governor also disclosed that a copy of the report would be forwarded to the Presidency for reference, underscoring the importance of the investigation and its outcome. ‎Earlier, the Chairman of the Commission, Justice Muhammad Muhammad, thanked the Governor for the confidence reposed in the panel and the opportunity to serve. ‎He explained that the Commission received nine memoranda, conducted public hearings and carried out inspection visits to two mining sites, two NSCDC offices and the General Hospital in Minna as part of its investigation. ‎Justice Muhammad said the evidence and facts gathered during the proceedings formed the basis of the Commission’s findings and recommendations. ‎He further explained that the report was presented in three volumes for ease of reference, with Volume One containing the findings, observations and recommendations; Volume Two containing the records of proceedings; and Volume Three comprising all exhibits tendered before the Commission. ‎In his remarks, the Attorney General and Commissioner for Justice, Nasiru Mu’azu, described the deaths of the 37 artisanal miners as a grave incident in the history of Niger State. ‎He commended Governor Bago for demonstrating commitment to the rule of law by establishing the Judicial Commission of Inquiry to investigate the incident and ensure that the circumstances surrounding the deaths were thoroughly examined. ‎Mu’azu assured that the Ministry of Justice would carefully study the report and advise the government on appropriate actions and the next steps to be taken. ‎ ‎ The post Gov Bago Receives Report On 37 Miners Deaths, Pledges Full Implementation Of Recommendations appeared first on Channels Television .

nigeria.title: FIFA confirms cyberattack, says hackers stole personal, business data
nigeria.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye FIFA has confirmed a criminal cyberattack that exposed a limited amount of personal and business information, while files linked to its abandoned World Cup stake-sale plan were not accessed. According to Reuters, a person with direct knowledge of the incident said less than 0.1 per cent of FIFA’s total data was affected and no files from the FIFA Forward Enterprise project were accessed. “FIFA can confirm that it has been the victim of a criminal cyberattack resulting in unauthorised access to a limited set of personal and business information,” a FIFA spokesperson told Reuters. The football governing body condemned the unlawful acquisition and publication of information, particularly personal data, calling it “a serious and unacceptable violation of privacy”. FIFA did not disclose when the attack took place, how many people or organisations were affected, or what business information was accessed. It also did not say whether any data had appeared online or where it may have been published. FIFA scrapped plans in July to sell private investors a stake in a new unit that would manage its events, including the World Cup. nigeria.title: Opposition coalition confirms Monday summit, to adopt 3 key documents
nigeria.description: By Omeiza Ajayi ABUJA: The Coalition for Democracy has confirmed that the Second Summit of Nigeria’s opposition political parties will hold on Monday in Abuja, with participating parties expected to adopt three foundational documents. The coalition is a multiparty platform pioneered by the African Democratic Congress (ADC), Allied Peoples Movement (APM), Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), Peoples Redemption Party (PRP) and Social Democratic Party (SDP). In a statement signed by Salihu Moh. Lukman on behalf of the coalition parties, it said the decision was reached on Wednesday night at the seventh meeting of its Central Leadership Committee. The statement said the leaders reached the decision “following extensive deliberations on the state of the nation, the prevailing political environment and the earlier resolution to suspend campaign activities on day of the Summit”. The leaders, however, made it clear that the suspension does not end inter-party engagement. “The leaders agreed that the suspension of campaign activities does not preclude the continuation of consultations and engagements among opposition political parties on matters of common interest, including electoral integrity, democratic participation and institutional reform,” the statement said. The documents to be considered and adopted are the National Covenant for Democratic Renewal, the Framework for Opposition Unity and the National Reform Programme. They were developed by working groups made up of representatives of the constituent parties after the inaugural summit of August 31, 2026. According to the statement, “the documents set out proposed mechanisms for inter-party cooperation and a framework for addressing national governance challenges.” The coalition leaders also reaffirmed their commitment “to working collectively to safeguard the integrity of the electoral process and protect the sanctity of the ballot across the country”. The coalition invited other opposition political parties to participate in the summit and “contribute to the ongoing consultations”. Three personalities will address the summit on the theme, “The Doctrine of a Necessary Democratic Opposition”. They are the Alaago of Kajola Alago, Ileshan, HRH Oba Oladipo Olaitan; Prof. Ango Abdullahi; and Chief S. N. Okeke. The statement said the summit is expected to bring together “national leaders of opposition political parties, elected representatives, former public officeholders, civil society leaders, representatives of the media, and observers from foreign diplomatic missions in Nigeria”. nigeria.title: Succession Battle: Court issues arrest warrant against Jimmy Odukoya
nigeria.description: By Henry Ojelu A Lagos State High Court sitting in Ikoyi has issued a bench warrant for the arrest of Pastor Jimmy Odukoya over his failure to appear in court in a contempt case arising from the leadership crisis at the Fountain of Life Church. Justice O. Adewunmi-Oshin issued the warrant on Thursday following Odukoya’s absence from proceedings in a suit instituted by the Incorporated Trustees of the church. The judge also directed that the case file be returned to the administrative judge for reassignment. The development followed an earlier order issued on November 18, restraining Odukoya from parading himself as the church’s Senior Pastor and Spiritual Head or interfering with its governance, administration and activities. The order was granted following an application by the church’s Incorporated Trustees. The leadership dispute became public on November 17 when a faction of the church’s Board of Trustees announced that Odukoya was no longer recognised as its Senior Pastor. The faction cited a review of the church’s constitution and a video recording allegedly containing succession instructions left by the late founder, Pastor Taiwo Odukoya. According to the trustees, the recording, made in December 2021, showed that the late cleric had preferred Pastor Kunle Areogun as his successor, while assigning Jimmy an administrative role and responsibility for the church’s youth ministry. They claimed the recording was not presented when Jimmy was appointed Senior Pastor in September 2023, following his father’s death. The trustees subsequently named Pastor Rotimi Okpaise as interim spiritual and administrative leader pending the establishment of a substantive leadership structure. However, Odukoya rejected his removal, insisting that it was not based on a valid decision of the church’s recognised Board of Trustees. The boat was conveying mourners from Ayama to Ukubie community in Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of the state for a burial ceremony when the tragedy occurred. One of the survivors, Mrs Lucy Africanist Olugbo, an indigene of Ijo-Gbanraun married in Ukubie, described the ill-fated vessel as an old boat unfit to carry the large number of passengers on board. Olugbo, who was travelling to attend the burial of her husband’s half-sister, said the passengers had initially expected to travel in a speedboat, but a local boat was eventually provided when none was available. She said the boat started making cracking sounds shortly after they boarded, raising concerns among some passengers. According to her, the vessel began tilting from side to side, prompting passengers to shift their weight in the same direction and further destabilising it. She said water had started entering the boat while it was still moving, triggering panic among the passengers. Recounting how she escaped, Olugbo said she secured a bag around her neck before pushing a heavy-set woman forward and jumping into the river. When she resurfaced, she said she saw men, women and children struggling desperately in the water. The survivor also alleged that some youths who arrived in boats, ostensibly to assist in the rescue operation, were more interested in collecting passengers’ phones, money, bags and other belongings than rescuing those struggling in the water. She said she personally witnessed four elderly women and a young woman die in the incident. Another survivor, Mrs Mary Silas, said she travelled with seven members of her household, including her children, younger sister and younger brother. Silas said she became particularly worried because one of her sons could not swim, prompting her to approach the boat driver and appeal to him to stop and allow some passengers to disembark. entertainment.title: As Nigeria Rethinks Teacher Education, Tunji Olowolafe Makes a Case for Better-Prepared Educators
entertainment.description: What makes a good teacher? Beyond knowing a subject, a good teacher can understand students, inspire confidence, and help young people discover what they are capable of becoming. It was this broader responsibility of educators that Dr. Tunji Olowolafe explored while delivering the 2026 Convocation Lecture at the Sikiru Adetona College of Education, Science and Technology (SACOETEC), Omu-Ajose, Ogun State. Speaking on Monday, 23 November 2026, on the theme “The Dual-Mandate NCE-Degree Programme: Prospects, Challenges and the Future of Teacher Education in Nigeria,” he described the programme as an important opportunity to reposition teacher education. For decades, Colleges of Education depended on university affiliations to award Bachelor’s degrees, despite many possessing the academic capacity to run such programmes. The Federal Colleges of Education Act 2023 changed this, empowering eligible institutions to award degrees independently. Under the Dual-Mandate programme, students can complete three years of NCE training and proceed to another two years for a Bachelor’s degree in Education. Dr. Olowolafe explained that combining practical teaching skills with deeper academic knowledge would produce better-prepared educators. However, he cautioned that institutional autonomy must be supported by sustained funding, improved curricula and professional development. With Nigeria facing an estimated shortage of one million teachers, he also called for greater integration of vocational education, artificial intelligence and digital skills into learning. “AI can explain a quadratic equation at midnight, but it cannot offer the steady, empathetic guidance of a caring adult,” he said, emphasizing that artificial intelligence must complement, not replace, the human qualities of effective teaching. According to an official statement released on behalf of the family by his eldest son, Leo Pete Edochie , the veteran actor and retired broadcaster departed this life at 12:30 a.m. in Enugu, Nigeria, following a protracted battle with prostate cancer. Born on 7 March 1947 in Zaria, Kaduna State, and hailing from Akamnato, Ifite Nteje in Anambra State, Pete Edochie began his career in broadcasting long before becoming a household name on television and cinema screens. At age 20, in 1967, he joined the Eastern Nigeria Broadcasting Service (ENBS)—later the Anambra Broadcasting Service (ABS)—rising steadily through the ranks to serve as Director of Programmes and Deputy Managing Director. His commanding presence and deep, resonant voice earned him international recognition—including a dedicated delegation interview from the BBC—and cemented his place in Nigerian television history. Over a screen career spanning nearly four decades, Pete Edochie became synonymous with authority,traditional wisdom, and unforgettable Igbo proverbs. Whether playing stern monarchs, principled elders, or complex patriarchs, he delivered every line with unmistakable gravitas. His extensive filmography includes standout appearances in classics and modern hits alike, such as Things Fall Apart (1987), Igodo (1999), Egg of Life (2003), Oracle (2003), Billionaires Club (2003), End of Money (2005), Lionheart (2018)—where he starred as Chief Ernest Obiagu alongside Genevieve Nnaji—Unroyal (2020), and Foreigner’s God (2022). entertainment.description: Williams Alamu marks his B.Sc. First-Class Honours graduation in Statistics from the University of Ibadan. There was a time when Williams Alamu would rather not sit an examination than risk getting a grade he wasn’t happy with. A B or a C in his Cambridge A-levels felt like a possibility he wasn’t ready to entertain, so he didn’t write the exams. A few years later, at 23, he has graduated from the University of Ibadan with a B.Sc. in Statistics, First-Class Honours and a CGPA of 3.65/4.0. Somewhere along the way, he decided that fear was no longer going to make his decisions for him. When Williams got into UI, he had a rather ambitious plan: become the Best Graduating Student in his faculty. Getting there would require more than good intentions. I knew becoming the overall Best Graduating Student in the university would require an extraordinary amount of work, but I felt being the best in my faculty was something I wanted to work towards. And, of course, that would also mean graduating as the best student in my department. entertainment.title: Solape Fayemi Launches Saina Properties Across Four Markets
entertainment.description: For many people, buying property is one of the biggest financial decisions they will ever make. Yet, knowing who to trust, how to verify ownership and whether a property is worth the investment can make the process overwhelming. It is a challenge Solape Fayemi hopes to address with the launch of Saina Properties , a real estate company now operating across Nigeria, the United Kingdom, the United States and the United Arab Emirates. Officially unveiled at an event held on 17 November at the Marriott Hotel, Ikeja GRA, Lagos, Saina Properties is built around a simple idea: property ownership should be guided by sound advice, proper verification and professional support, not just the excitement of closing a deal. For Solape, whose experience in the investment industry shaped her understanding of money, risk and wealth creation, the decision to establish the company came from recognising the need for a more considered approach to real estate. “We are not building Saina Properties because the world needs another company selling properties. We are building Saina because we believe there is room for a different kind of real estate experience. That philosophy is reflected in the company’s three core areas of expertise: Advisory & Verification, Sales & Brokerage, and Developments . Rather than focusing solely on connecting buyers to properties, Saina brings together the guidance investors need to assess opportunities, the support required to navigate property transactions, and involvement in real estate development. The company is also building on experience gained before its official launch, having supported more than 25 clients with property opportunities across different markets. An important part of its proposition is the role of professional expertise in protecting property investors. While trust and family relationships matter, they do not automatically translate into the technical knowledge needed to assess a property, verify its documentation or understand its investment potential. These decisions require proper checks, market understanding and accountability. sports.title: “RIZE Up Day” aims to empower Western PA middle schoolers
sports.description: WPXI Approximately 200 middle school students from the Aliquippa and Shaler Area school districts gathered at the RIZE Sports Complex in Leetsdale on Tuesday for “RIZE Up Day.” The four-hour program engaged sixth-, seventh- and eighth-grade students in sports training, health workshops and career exploration. Organized by the Boys & Girls Clubs of Western Pennsylvania and hosted by RIZE Sports, the event took place at 1201 Brickworks Dr. Program organizers structured the day to help young people build confidence, maintain active lifestyles and learn about career opportunities in the sports and wellness industries. Chuck Cooper III addressed the students as the keynote speaker following opening remarks. Cooper is the president and chief executive officer of the Chuck Cooper Foundation. He is the son of Charles “Chuck” Cooper, the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame member who became the first African American drafted into the NBA. Participants took part in physical training spread across three activity rotations. Community coaches from the Cleveland Cavaliers directed basketball skills sessions, while players from the University of Pittsburgh women’s lacrosse team led agility and conditioning drills. Beyond athletics, the morning incorporated wellness and emergency response education. Representatives from the Children’s Institute of Pittsburgh guided students through mindfulness and yoga rotations. In a separate hands-on session, instructors from the American Heart Association provided students with foundational CPR training to teach basic life-saving skills. During lunch sessions, students attended a panel discussion focused on professional careers in sports. Jim Britt, executive director of SportsPITTSBURGH, served as moderator. The panel featured Rachel Brecht, chief people officer of the Pittsburgh Penguins; Ethan Lounsbury, senior director of marketing for the Pittsburgh Riverhounds; and Benjamin Moore, senior sports marketing manager at F.N.B. Freigang will be suspended until October 7, 2027 after she reached a settlement with the DFB, the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) and Germany's National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA). Proceedings against Freigang had been ongoing for months. The 28-year-old was accused of not being at the location she specified for a doping control on three occasions between March 2025 and February 2026. In June, the Eintracht Frankfurt captain explained that the missed tests "were not deliberately avoided appointments but inconsistencies or misunderstandings in the comprehensive details that have to be updated daily and which we as national team players have to update in the system on a daily and hourly basis." Freigang has 45 caps for Germany and has scored 17 goals, but hasn't been a regular starter recently.

One of them was Lane Hutson, who recorded 66 points with the Montreal Canadiens in 2024-25. Just two seasons later, his younger brother has a legitimate opportunity to become the fifth. Cole Hutson took over the NHL rookie scoring lead after recording three assists in the Washington Capitals’ 7-4 loss to the New Jersey Devils on Nov. 14. At the time, Hutson was the only defenseman among the league’s top 13 rookie scorers. The 20-year-old has since been overtaken by some of the young forwards having incredible rookie seasons of their own, but he scored his sixth goal of the season in Wednesday’s 7-3 victory over the Philadelphia Flyers, bringing him up to 16 points in 22 games and within four points of rookie scoring leader Roman Kantserov. Considering some of the talent that entered the league this season, the fact that we’re even having this conversation about Hutson is pretty remarkable. Cole Hutson Could Join Some Incredible Company Bobby Orr became the first defenseman in the NHL’s modern era to lead all rookies in scoring, recording 41 points with the Boston Bruins in 1966-67. It took another 22 years for a defenseman to accomplish the feat, with Brian Leetch recording 71 points for the New York Rangers in 1988-89. Quinn Hughes became the third with 53 points for the Vancouver Canucks in 2019-20 before Lane joined the group with his incredible rookie season in Montreal. Cole is currently scoring at a rate that would see him finish with roughly 61 points over an 84-game season. It would be an incredible accomplishment on its own, but imagine both Hutson brothers leading their respective rookie classes in scoring just two years apart. Neither was even selected in the first round of their draft. The Canadiens selected Lane 62nd overall in 2022, while the Capitals selected Cole 43rd overall in 2024. There are going to be plenty of conversations in the coming years about how so many teams managed to pass on both of them. The 6-foot-3 Bauer and the 6-2 Jeannot dropped the gloves near the center circle, then circled for about 20 seconds, looking for the right moment to make their move, before throwing more than 40 punches over nearly a minute in the Jets’ 4-2 victory over the Bruins. Not every punch landed, but Bauer’s helmet was knocked off, Jeannot got spun around, and when it was over and they were in the penalty box, both benches emptied, and the players went over to fist pound their respective teammates. Tyrel Bauer #77 of the Winnipeg Jets and Tanner Jeannot #84 of the Boston Bruins fight during a game at TD Garden in Boston, Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026. NHLI via Getty Images “One of the best fights I’ve seen,” said Bruins second-year coach Marco Sturm, who played in the NHL for 14 seasons. “Jeano, holy moly,” Sturm said. “Unbelievable.” Jeannot and Bauer were seen on the ice talking during warmups and, likely, planned to square off. Talk about letting the boys go What a fight pic.twitter.com/ZPDZTDuD5G — Barstool Sports (@barstoolsports) November 26, 2026 They earned the respect of their teammates by trying to boost the energy for their respective teams. “That’s just two really tough customers,” said Jets center Morgan Barron, who scored a second-period go-ahead goal. “You see Tyrel in those fights, he stands in there as long as the other guy is willing to. I think it was just great, it got the guys some energy. That’s a really difficult job to do.” The Bruins felt the same way. “It’s unbelievable,’’ said Boston center Fraser Minten of Jeannot. “He’s like the nicest guy, an unbelievable teammate. Just an absolute warrior out there.” The Boston Bruins bench looks on as a first-period fight between Tyrel Bauer and Tanner Jeannot on Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026, at TD Garden in Boston. NHLI via Getty Images Sturm has certainly seen his share of “tough guys” or what the league used to call “enforcers,” but he has great respect for what the two had to do. “I came in as young kid in this league and all the fights were pretty much open and you just go,” he said. “There was no defense, no structure. You just: ‘Go, Go.’ “That was wild,” he said. “In today’s world, there’s a lot of technique. … In today’s game, I think Jeano is elite and he showed it today.”

sports.title: Where RBL currently stand in the race for the UCL play-offs
sports.description: Where RBL currently stand in the race for the UCL play-offs Following our 3-1 win over RC Lens , the Red Bulls now sit 23rd in the table , putting us in a play-off spot. There are three games left in the Champions League league phase, and we're determined to pick up as many points as possible ! “ Every game is important now , which is why today's win was so valuable. We've still got a few games to play and we want to try and pick up as many points as possible. Every point counts ,” Antonio Nusa said afterwards. Manchester United clash could prove pivotal for RBL Automatic qualification for the Champions League round of 16 still looks some way off, with four points separating us from eighth-placed Manchester City . Having already faced two of the competition's strongest sides in Real Madrid and Manchester City during the first half of the league phase, we've got three challenging but winnable games ahead of us . A win away at Manchester United in two weeks' time would see us leapfrog the Red Devils, who currently sit 19th with seven points. United drew 2-2 with Sporting CP on matchday 5 under new head coach Mauricio Pochettino . It's been a difficult season for the English side, who currently sit second from bottom in the Premier League . Our two remaining opponents, Shakhtar Donetsk (26th) and Feyenoord (32nd), are both below us in the standings. They suffered 1-0 defeats to Fenerbahçe and Porto respectively. “We'll go to Manchester full of belief” RBL are off to the iconic Old Trafford on 8th December, where we've got some unfinished business. We suffered a 5-0 defeat in Manchester back in 2020, but won the reverse fixture 3-2 at the Red Bull Arena . “We've been making good progress as a team for several weeks now. We'll go to Manchester full of belief and try to get all three points. It won't be easy, but we'll be ready and we'll fight ,” said Martín Demichelis . Nine points were enough to secure a play-off spot last season, while 11 were needed in 2024/25 , the first season under the new league phase format. We missed out on the knockout stages that year, finishing with just three points. With three games and nine points up for grabs, the Red Bulls have one clear goal : reaching the Champions League round of 16 for the first time since 2023/24. sports.title: Real Madrid superstar equals Ferenc Puskas’ record with goal against PSV
sports.description: Real Madrid superstar equals Ferenc Puskas’ record with goal against PSV Real Madrid staged an excellent second-half comeback to secure a 5-1 win over PSV Eindhoven in the UEFA Champions League this midweek. Kylian Mbappe scored a brace and was subsequently nominated for the UCL Player of the Week . But the Frenchman had actually gifted his MOTM award to Vinicius Jr. It was an important game for the Brazilian international, who scored for Real Madrid for the first time in three months. In doing so, he has achieved a key milestone. Vinicius Jr. levels Puskas’ record Thanks to his late goal against PSV, Vinicius has now netted his 35th goal for Real Madrid in the Champions League, drawing him level with club legend Ferenc Puskas, reports Defensa Central . It was a special night for Vinicius. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images) Vinicius Jr. now stands fifth in the all-time list of goalscorers for Real Madrid in the competition, behind only an iconic quartet of Alfredo Di Stefano (49), Raul Gonzalez (66), Karim Benzema (78) and Cristiano Ronaldo (105). This is quite the achievement for a player who has been central to Real Madrid’s recent success and has already bagged two Champions League trophies. In the overall scheme of things, Vinicius currently sits 24th, just one goal behind Puskas. His teammate Kylian Mbappe is further ahead in fifth spot with 76 goals, but a majority of them came in PSG colours. A touching show of unity Apart from the milestone, it was a special goal for Vinicius in many ways, as the forward has been struggling with form throughout the entirety of the season so far. Vinicius Jr. has shown early signs of promise. (Photo by Denis Doyle/Getty Images) That is why the Real Madrid team showed exceptional unity when the Brazilian international did eventually find the back of the net, with Mbappe being at the heart of it. Despite being named the MOTM, the Frenchman handed the award to Vinicius, in a gesture of recognition for his efforts on the night. Vinicius Jr. himself was moved by the gesture and thanked his teammates after the game. “Very happy for how my teammates have celebrated a goal that I needed. We are a family. Thank you very much, really. I love you all, let’s go for more!” he wrote after the game. This chimes in well with reports that the entire Real Madrid team are now all in on helping Vini get back to his best.

sports.title: James Jones says Aaron Rodgers’ rant on Pat McAfee’s show wasn’t even the most disappointing part
sports.description: Photo by Joe Sargent/Getty Images Aaron Rodgers’ rant on the Pat McAfee show has shaken the NFL, but his former teammate James Jones is more disappointed by what happened on the show itself. The sanctity of the locker room was broken in astonishing fashion by Aaron Rodgers recently on the Pat McAfee show. Following his benching against the Denver Broncos, Rodgers went off on the Pittsburgh Steelers and head coach Mike McCarthy. What happened on the Pat McAfee show was hard to digest, but Rodgers’ former teammate, James Jones, is more disappointed by what happened around it. James Jones calls out AJ Hawk on Pat McAfee show Coincidentally, when Rodgers was going off on the Steelers and McCarthy, AJ Hawk was among the panellists on the Pat McAfee show. Hawk is a Super Bowl winner with the Green Bay Packers, played under McCarthy for nine years, and was also Rodgers’ teammate during that same span. Considering the statements Rodgers was saying with abandon on the show, James Jones felt disappointed that Hawk didn’t interrupt him once. Jones was a part of that same locker room, and hit back at Rodgers’ claim while speaking on Speakeasy . He said: “Coach Mike and Aaron have been with each other for almost 15 years, more than half of his career. And the most disappointing thing in this too on the Pat McAfee show is that AJ Hawk is sitting there. I don’t remember any of this at the Packers. “If you are from where I’m from, if I have a problem with you, I will call you and tell you that. I’m not going to go to the Pat McAfee show and downplay or talk badly about you.” Rodgers perhaps wouldn’t have expected the majority of the NFL ecosystem to side with McCarthy instead of him, but that is what the gravity of the situation is. The way he threw everyone under the bus at the Steelers after being benched was not very leader-like, and is especially not expected of a veteran of the game. Rodgers has probably ended his chances of landing with another NFL team after this. If that’s the case, it’s a sad end to one of the more illustrious careers in the league. sports.title: MAC admits error on overturned Kent State touchdown that decided Eastern Michigan’s season finale
sports.description: The Mid-American Conference said Wednesday that its replay official got the final play of the Kent State Golden Flashes’ season wrong, and that the touchdown wiped off the board in Tuesday night’s 17-12 loss to the Eastern Michigan Eagles should have counted. Kent State faced fourth-and-9 from the Eastern Michigan 14-yard line with six seconds left when Ethan Thanthanavong found Wayne Harris in the end zone. The officials on the field ruled it a touchdown, which would have put the Golden Flashes ahead in Ypsilanti. The replay review overturned it, ruling that Harris did not have firm control of the ball until his left foot was off the ground and that his right foot then landed out of bounds. The pass went down as incomplete, and Eastern Michigan held on. Samson Evans rushes for a big gain. Associated Press In its postgame evaluation, the league found that the video showed only slight movement of the football and did not establish that Harris lacked or lost control of it. “The video evidence did not meet the clear and obvious standard required to overturn the ruling on the field. The decision to overturn the touchdown was incorrect, and the original ruling should have been upheld,” the MAC said . The conference added that it regretted the effect the error had on the outcome. Kent State’s record still stands at 3-9 and 2-6 in MAC play, and the season is over, so the statement is all the Golden Flashes get for a catch the league now says was a game-winner. News: The MAC says Kent State’s game-winning touchdown at EMU last night should NOT have been overturned. https://t.co/F2GL5AjjrQ https://t.co/8S4AmmWbgF — Chris Vannini (@ChrisVannini) November 25, 2026 Eastern Michigan ended the Chris Creighton era the same day The statement landed hours after Eastern Michigan announced that it and Chris Creighton had parted ways after 13 seasons. The last win of his tenure is one his own conference has now said should have gone the other way. Creighton went 66-90 with the Eagles, and those 66 wins rank second in school history. He took Eastern Michigan to six bowl games, including three straight from 2021 to 2023, and his 2022 team went 9-4 and won the Famous Idaho Potato Bowl for the program’s first bowl victory since 1987. Every season since then has ended with a losing record. The disputed result did not move Eastern Michigan’s postseason status in either direction. At 5-7, the Eagles finished a win short of bowl eligibility, and a 4-8 finish would have left them in the same place. A touchdown on the final snap would have sent Kent State into the offseason with a conference road win. Harris’ catch instead stays in the books as an incomplete pass, and the final score in Ypsilanti remains 17-12, now with the league’s written acknowledgment that the first call on the field was right. sports.title: Barcelona optimistic about veteran duo returning from injury against Deportivo – report
sports.description: Barcelona optimistic about veteran duo returning from injury against Deportivo – report Barcelona are optimistic that Rodri and Andreas Christensen will be available for Sunday’s La Liga visit to Deportivo de A Coruna, with both players scheduled to undergo a final fitness test in Friday’s training session. According to Mundo Deportivo , the pair have made encouraging progress from their respective injuries, giving Hansi Flick the possibility of adding two more options to his squad for the match, which will be played on November 29. Mind you, neither return is confirmed, however, and Friday’s assessment will determine whether they are ready to be included. Rodri’s recovery offers Barcelona midfield boost Rodri is recovering from a minor injury to the biceps femoris in his right leg, sustained during Barcelona’s Champions League match against Aston Villa on November 3. The midfielder has been feeling positive about his recovery, and the aforementioned outlet believes he is likely to be available against Deportivo. Barcelona are optimistic that Rodri will play against Deportivo. (Picture credit: Barcelona official website) His return would be timely for Flick, as Rodri has missed important matches against Atletico Madrid, Villarreal and Sabah. The club will nevertheless need to assess his readiness and is expected not to rush him back. Even with a demanding run of fixtures approaching, a short appearance could help him regain match fitness ahead of more important games. Christensen also close to returning Meanwhile, Christensen has been s idelined by discomfort in his left calf , which ruled him out of Barcelona’s recent matches against Villarreal and Sabah. The Danish defender has also progressed well and will face the same final test as Rodri. Andreas Christensen did not play against Villarreal and Sabah. (Photo by Daniela Porcelli/Getty Images) His potential return would provide Flick with another option in central defence, an area where Barcelona have recently dealt with several fitness problems. Christensen’s availability could help reduce the need to rely on players covering unfamiliar positions during a congested schedule, such as Frenkie de Jong, who has played as centre-back against Villarreal and Sabah. Balde and Yamal remain part of the fitness picture Apart from Rodri and Christensen, Barcelona also need to monitor Alejandro Balde, who left the Sabah match with ankle discomfort after an impressive performance. His condition will be assessed following the injury in Baku. Lamine Yamal, meanwhile, did not travel to Azerbaijan because of a minor ankle issue but is expected to be available against Deportivo. As such, the squad did not train today as players recovered from the long journey back from Baku, meaning that Friday’s session will be important not only for Rodri and Christensen, but also for understanding the overall condition of the team.

sports.title: Resurfaced clip of Mike McCarthy admitting to lying to secure Dallas Cowboys job goes viral
sports.description: Photo by Tom Pennington/Getty Images Amid the controversy stirred up by Aaron Rodgers with his comments about Mike McCarthy, the former Dallas Cowboys’ head coach’s first day on the job is going viral. Following a 12-year stint with the Green Bay Packers, McCarthy had to wait two years before he got his next head coaching opportunity. But amid criticism of his coaching style and general honesty in dealings, McCarthy’s first comments upon becoming head coach of the Cowboys have started to go viral. Mike McCarthy openly admitted he lied to Jerry Jones about watching the Dallas Cowboys During his introductory press conference as the head coach of the Dallas Cowboys in 2020, Mike McCarthy revealed his negotiation tactics with Jerry Jones. McCarthy claimed that he had told Jones that he watched every snap the Cowboys played in the 2019 season, and then admitted he had told a lie just to secure the job, which elicited laughter from the whole room. “Well, I need to confess,” McCarthy started out. “I told Jerry that I watched every play of the 2019 season, but I wanted the job. I haven’t watched every play of the season, but you do what you gotta do, right?” Given the recent controversy surrounding Aaron Rodgers’ comments about McCarthy, this clip from over six years ago has now caught the eye of several fans. Many fans questioned how this wasn’t a more talked-about incident, given that McCarthy said that about the Dallas Cowboys, one of the NFL teams that draws a significant amount of media interest. However, others have pointed out that McCarthy was clearly joking. But even if he was, making such a joke during the most important press conference of your career is certainly a poor look. Regardless, this video resurfacing has shown just how much scrutiny McCarthy finds himself facing after Rodgers’ explosive interview. sports.title: Liverpool v Man Utd referee made ‘obvious error’ sending off Leny Yoro as written reasons published
sports.description: Referee Sam Barrott made an “obvious error” by giving Manchester United defender Leny Yoro a red card against Liverpool, an independent regulatory commission unanimously concluded. Yoro was given his marching orders when he hauled down Swedish striker Alexander Isak in the opening stages of last Sunday’s fiery match at Anfield. Debate raged over Isak’s touch and whether goalkeeper Senne Lammens would have collected the ball had Yoro not made contact. Even referees’ chief Howard Webb concluded that the call was “certainly not clearly wrong”, but then Manchester United appealed to the Football Association for wrongful dismissal and successfully removed his one-match ban on Tuesday. Referee Sam Barrott made an “obvious error” in sending off Manchester United’s Leny Yoro at Liverpool, an independent commission unanimously concluded (Martin Rickett/PA) (PA Wire) The three-person panel’s written reasons were published on Thursday and stated: “The commission members were unanimous that, taking the foul committed by LY (Yoro) out of the scenario, AI (Isak) would not have had an obvious goalscoring opportunity. “Despite the fact that AI had reached the ball initially, his touch was heavy to the extent that he had in fact lost control of the ball – that control had, in effect, passed to the advancing MUFC goalkeeper who in the view of the commission would have been able to gather or smother the ball before AI could get to it and shoot at goal. “To the mind of the commission, the referee had made an ‘obvious error’ in deciding that AI (Isak) would have had an obvious goalscoring opportunity.” Webb, the chief refereeing officer at Pro Ref, told the Match Officials: Mic’d Up programme which aired on Tuesday, shortly after confirmation the ban had been removed: “There’s a question mark I guess around whether or not he (Isak) would get onto that ball before Lammens. Now, in the moment, the referee looked at it and felt he would. “The VAR checks to see whether that decision made on the field was clearly and obviously incorrect, and formed the opinion that it wasn’t. “I think by and large, most people would see that as a correct decision, with Isak moving quickly on towards that ball. The alternative view is that Lammens might get there first, but I think it’s a little bit debatable. (It’s) certainly not clearly wrong.” (Getty) The FA’s independent panel, which was made up of former Blackburn and Middlesbrough winger Stuart Ripley, former Sheffield United and Notts County forward Tony Agana and ex-Walsall goalkeeper Mick Kearns, disagreed. The reasons confirm that United submitted technical information to the panel which concluded Isak would have been, at best, 1.8 metres short of the ball even if Yoro had not made the challenge. The reasons state that the commission “had no way of testing the validity of this analysis undertaken by the club and as such the evidence was viewed with caution and allocated weight accordingly”. sports.title: Liberty enters final week with NCAA probation after tampering case involving three staffers
sports.description: The NCAA’s Division I Committee on Infractions released its decision in the Liberty Flames’ tampering case on Tuesday, putting the No. 21 program on probation as it heads into the final week of a 10-1 regular season. Assistant coaches Newland Isaac and Tony Washington and director of player personnel Colton Korn had impermissible contact with two players, and with representatives for those players, while the athletes were enrolled at another NCAA school and had not entered the transfer portal. The Associated Press identified that school as the Monmouth Hawks. Neither player ended up transferring to Liberty. Liberty, the three staffers and the NCAA enforcement staff agreed on the violations and penalties through the negotiated resolution process, and a hearing panel signed off on the deal. The school receives one year of probation and a $25,000 fine , along with three-week bans on football recruiting communication and unofficial visits during the 2026-27 academic year. Dec 1, 2023; Lynchburg, VA, USA; Liberty Flames quarterback Kaidon Salter (7) holds up the Conference USA MVP trophy after the game against the New Mexico State Aggies at Williams Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Brian Bishop-USA TODAY Sports The program also loses 3% of its official visits, based on its average over the previous four years, and 5% of its permissible recruiting person days. Washington drew the heaviest individual penalty, a two-year show-cause order and a two-game suspension that he served on Sept. 5 and Sept. 12. Isaac and Korn each received a one-year show-cause order and a one-game suspension, served Sept. 5 against the James Madison Dukes. Head coach Jamey Chadwell was held responsible under the NCAA’s head coach responsibility rules, though the parties agreed he did not know about the contact, in part because of significant health issues, and did not condone it. He served a one-week ban on recruiting communication from Sept. 3 to Sept. 10. #BREAKING: Liberty will be ineligible for the 2026 CUSA Championship Game following NCAA recruiting tampering violations. Delaware at Jacksonville State is now the projected matchup, pending Week 13 results. https://t.co/xTM5iJxEt2 — TheCUSACentel (@TheCUSACentel) November 25, 2026 Liberty’s place in the CUSA title game holds The penalty list includes no postseason ban, and Liberty, 7-0 in Conference USA, has already clinched a spot in the conference championship game against the Jacksonville State Gamecocks, set for Friday, Dec. 4, at 6 p.m. ET on CBS Sports Network.
